cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Be Right in Retrospect
cards.instruction: Perform certainty by reinterpreting every surprise as something your earlier words were obviously predicting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: When I said the evening would flow, I meant this kitchen flood. I taught you to listen to the exact words before guessing what comes next.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're remembering the conversation now. Good. And what are we all talking about? The water. You can give me that much.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You didn't predict a burst pipe.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I said something would have to open up before the evening improved. Repeat the words carefully, as I taught you: 'open up'. What has that pipe just done?

reason: Final local spoken edit removes redundant interpretation labels, paperwork and extra requests. Keep each final contribution directly tied to B actual question and the exact prior clue or confession.
